args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 began failing health checks in production following its deployment. Per runbook, rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback completed and verified across all regions. v2.3.1 (and its staging counterpart v2.3.1-rc) should not be redeployed until root cause of the health check failures is identified and fixed.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

**Investigation:** Deployment history showed the latest deploy, **v2.3.1**, was unhealthy in production, while **v2.3.0** was the most recent healthy release.

**Rollback:** Rolled back checkout-api to **v2.3.0** across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollout completed and was verified successfully.

**Incident:** Opened **INC-0001** (SEV2, on-call paged) documenting the failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and a note not to redeploy v2.3.1 until the root cause is identified and fixed.
